## Panel B — Mitochondrial volume quantification

Per-cell mitochondrial volumes were quantified from fluorescence microscopy images
using the following image analysis pipeline:

1. **Image preprocessing** — Fiji macro scripts in `Macro Script for imageJ/`
   were used for channel cropping and maximum-intensity projection.
2. **Cell segmentation** — Cell boundaries were segmented using
   [Cellpose](https://cellpose.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) to obtain per-cell masks.
3. **Mitochondrial volume** — The mitochondrial network volume per cell was
   quantified using [MitoGraph](https://github.com/vianamp/MitoGraph).

The figure was assembled in Fiji. Per-cell measurements are in
`figure5/source_data/Figure 5 - source data.xlsx` (sheet: Figure 5B).
The sheet contains three conditions (Proliferation, Carbon starvation, Phosphorus
starvation) \u00d7 two genotypes (WT, rim15\u0394), one measurement per row per column.

```{r panel-B-source-data}
raw <- read_excel(file.path(data_dir, "Figure 5 - source data.xlsx"),
                  sheet = "Figure 5B", col_names = FALSE)

# Row 1: overall label; row 2: condition; row 3: genotype; rows 4+: values
conditions <- as.character(raw[2, ])
for (i in seq_along(conditions))
  if (is.na(conditions[i]) && i > 1) conditions[i] <- conditions[i - 1]
genotypes <- as.character(raw[3, ])

mito_vol <- map2_dfr(seq_len(ncol(raw)), conditions, function(col_i, cond) {
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw[[col_i]][4:nrow(raw)]))
  tibble(condition = cond, genotype = genotypes[col_i],
         mito_volume_um3 = vals[!is.na(vals)])
}) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = recode(condition,
      "phosphorus starvation" = "Phosphorus starvation"),
    condition = factor(condition,
      levels = c("Proliferation", "Carbon starvation", "Phosphorus starvation")),
    genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("WT", "rim15\u0394"))
  )

stopifnot(nrow(mito_vol) > 0, all(c("WT", "rim15\u0394") %in% mito_vol$genotype))
message("Figure 5B source data: ", nrow(mito_vol), " per-cell measurements")
mito_vol %>% count(condition, genotype)
```
